question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for a governor for each state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 153**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 153** of the Constitution of India provides for a Governor for each state.
 
• The Governor acts as the nominal head of a state, while the real power is exercised by the Chief Minister and the state's council of ministers.
 
• The Governor is appointed by the President of India and holds office at the President's pleasure.
 
• The role of the Governor includes summoning the state legislature, giving assent to bills, and ensuring that the state's administration runs according to the provisions of the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written** constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The role and powers of the Governor are also mentioned in other articles of the Constitution, such as Article 154 (Executive power of State) and Article 155 (Appointment of Governor).
